requirement_dispositions.requirement: Every driver of a vehicle approaching a stop intersection indicated by a stop sign shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, shall stop at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting highway before entering the intersection.
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Native original body-front/velocity samples and hierarchy geometry; independent legal reference-point and stopping judgment.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Crosswalk first, marked line only if no crosswalk, nearest sight point only if neither; marked and sidewalk-prolongation crosswalk definitions.
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Native original body-front/velocity samples and hierarchy geometry; independent legal reference-point and stopping judgment.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Nearest-point sight evidence retains driver-view collision-ray samples and scan resolution; do not infer continuous optical view.

dev.stop_sign.evidence: crosswalk_geometry.json stop_sign_landmarks actual Native type-206 inventory plus scene.xodr sign source; authority provenance independently sourced.

dev.governs.evidence: crosswalk_geometry.json governed_approach_road_id and original stop-sign landmark road identity; sign-facing original pixels and legal authority separate.

st.lane_enters.evidence: scene.xodr road1->junction11->road2 lane-link connection and stop_history.jsonl road/lane identities.

drv.approaching.evidence: stop_history.jsonl every full-body vertex, speed and road/lane identity before intersection boundary.

st.crosswalk.evidence: crosswalk_geometry.json branch, physical_marking_inventory and marked tile bounds; unmarked branch uses physical sidewalks in scene.xodr and their boundary prolongations.

st.stop_line.evidence: crosswalk_geometry.json stopline_also_present, branch and physical tile body bounds; line branch selected only when crosswalk absent.

st.intersection.evidence: scene.xodr joining road curb/edge geometry and connected junction lane links; full stop_history.jsonl body trajectory.

st.sight_distance.evidence: nearest_sight_samples from sight_samples.json finite driver-eye candidate positions, target positions and actual Native collision hits at .25m scan resolution; continuous nearest point unresolved.

rel.visible.evidence: sight_samples.json separate candidate driver-eye rays and hit labels to approaching-road targets; collision rays do not establish optical recognizability or original pixel visibility.

drv.stopped.evidence: stop_before_crosswalk original sampled speed_mps and body position history; full legal cessation requires independent physical review, no epsilon is a legal stop definition.

drv.crossing_line.evidence: stop_before_crosswalk full-body front signed distance and first crossing frame relative to branch-specific reference, preserving every original velocity.

drv.entering_intersection.evidence: stop_history.jsonl full original body trajectory/road_id versus scene.xodr qualifying intersection edge boundaries; no chosen legal vehicle reference point.

coverage.subject: All participant bodies and route context
